name: Halberd Elite
headerMeta: Heroic era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 225 leadership · T4
pitch: A shield-line shredder that ignores block and demands the front lane, with the staying power to punish grouped enemies. Recently buffed on cooldown and armour penetration, but needs support — the 30% mitigation window from ability 2 is its only defence.

doctrines.name: Epic Bloodthirsty Doctrine
doctrines.effect: 12% lifesteal for 6s after dealing damage, +12% DMG when HP above 60%.

doctrines.name: Toughness Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: -33% DMG taken on first hit, scaling down over 8 hits until it expires.

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: More consistent across all scenario types; both viable. {1}

battleRole.positioning: Front lane only — low HP solo. {1}
battleRole.tips: X-move in, press 2 to grab the enemy, then press 1; ability 2 resets CC and grants 30% dmg reduction. {1} Cloud Cleave cooldown recently buffed to 5s with +10% armour penetration. {2}

cards.name: Wuwei
cards.why: upgraded Wuwei with block penetration, trades better but lacks range {1}

controls.notes: Ability 2 grabs enemy and resets CC. {1} Ability 1 follows, resetting the CC chain and applying 30% dmg reduction. {1}
